dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: Hmm. Nothing that warrants my attention, no. But nearby, you say... That reminds me of a Domovoy who came to me asking for help in tempering crystal...

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: She appears to have found Rainbowdrop Crystal nearby, and even agreed to bring me some.

dialogues.speaker: Kuzmichev
dialogues.text: You can have a look for yourself if the fancy strikes you. Here, that's the location she mentioned. I've marked it out for you.
